source:
version: '1'
kind: miner
id: 0
slug: truth-worldbank-wdi-unemployment
protocol: generic
name: World Bank WDI unemployment rate (SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS)
description: >-
  Free, public, no-key World Bank Indicators API. Returns the unemployment rate, total (% of total labour force,
  modeled ILO estimate), World Bank indicator SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS, for one country and one year. Data CC BY 4.0.
base_url: https://api.worldbank.org
auth:
  type: none
docs:
  website: https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS
  documentation: https://datahelpdesk.worldbank.org/knowledgebase/articles/889392
endpoints:
  - path: /unemployment
    external_path: /v2/country/{country}/indicator/SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS
    method: GET
    description: >-
      Unemployment rate (% of total labour force, World Bank SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS) for one country in one year.
      USE THIS for MACRO_ECONOMIC_INDICATOR_GENERAL. The answer is a JSON array; the value is at [1][0].value.
    intents:
      - MACRO_ECONOMIC_INDICATOR_GENERAL
    params:
      path:
        required:
          - name: country
            type: string
            intents: ['*']
            description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code, upper case (e.g. DEU, BRA, ZAF).
      query:
        required:
          - name: date
            type: string
            intents: ['*']
            description: The four-digit year, e.g. 2020.
          - name: format
            type: string
            intents: ['*']
            description: Always json.
intent_mapping:
  MACRO_ECONOMIC_INDICATOR_GENERAL:
    endpoint: /unemployment
    input:
      country: { from: country, how: "ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code, upper case (Germany -> DEU, United States -> USA)." }
      date: { from: year }
      format: { from: const, value: json }
    output:
      rate_pct: { path: "1.0.value" }
semantics:
  supported_intents:
    - MACRO_ECONOMIC_INDICATOR_GENERAL
